dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: A fascinating copy... You have attended to every fine detail — even the feeling of the wilderness that one can only experience when adventuring themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Alright then. I'll go ahead and start sketching.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Would you mind... if I make you the subject matter of my sketch?
